The Command Center is found in the Interface tab. It allows you to enter
commands or directions to a model. Commands are instructions you can give to
NetLogo’s agents: turtles, patches, links, and the observer.

To be able to make more changes to the colors of turtles and patches, or shall
we say cars and backgrounds, we need to gain a little insight into how NetLogo
deals with colors.

In NetLogo, colors have a numeric value. In all of the exercises we have been
using the name of the color. This is because NetLogo recognizes 16 different
color names. This does not mean that NetLogo only recognizes 16 colors. There
are many shades in between these colors that can be used too. Here’s a chart
that shows the whole NetLogo color space:
